display_name: MDEQ 2024 303(d) Impaired Waters and TMDL Complete Waters
known_limitations: Screening-level water-quality context from MDEQ 2024 impaired waters and TMDL-complete layers.
Does not independently establish watershed context; pair with HUC/NHD layers when watershed or hydrologic context is needed.
Older 2022, 2020, 2018, and 2016 MDEQ REST services were reviewed but not used because the 2024 service was the newest usable service found.
notes: Raw GeoJSON exports preserve MDEQ attributes and add review_assist_source_year/list_year/status fields for provenance. Paths are relative to this source manifest directory.
